name: urgeaway-screen-pinning
description: Local Capacitor plugin: thin bridge to Android's built-in Screen Pinning / App Pinning feature (Activity#startLockTask / #stopLockTask) and, on iOS, to Guided Access state — for UrgeAway's Urge Lock feature. Uses only standard public APIs on both platforms — no Device Owner/Device Policy Manager, no ADB/root, no Accessibility Service workaround, no private iOS URL schemes.
